descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S18 A placed box with orders, a med change and a 'Task:' code word creates no task, no medication row and no note

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Assigning does not create tasks, record medication events, or generate a note. Those happen only when the physician opens that patient's Encounter tab and taps Save & Extract. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given QA Hosp Patel (415), no tasks, no medications, no note

When Place 'Bed 415. Start lisinopril 10 mg daily. Hold metoprolol for heart rate in the 50s. Recheck BMP in the morning. New admission from the ED today. Task: call daughter at 5 pm.' with Link, wait 5 s, open Patel's Encounter, Pre-Round and Post-Round tabs

Then Text is in the encounter note; Tasks empty (the code-word clause too, although its capture needs no model); Medications empty; no note generated. Tasks and medication events appear only after Save & Extract (S26)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp1 Encounter mustContain the full text and 'No pending tasks' — a code-word task 'call daughter at 5 pm' would replace 'No pending tasks'; a page-wide mustNotContain is not used because the note itself holds the words (oracle.mjs has no section scope); cp2 Pre-Round mustContain 'No medications recorded yet.'; …

Where it ran: dev unit U03; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
